title: Godot v4.4-dev crashes on startup
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.4-dev1 - v4.4-dev5
Works fine for any version prior

### System information

Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 - X11 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (RADV NAVI22) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 Threads)

### Issue description

When trying to launch the Godot application on Linux, it crashes before it can even load the project manager.
